title: Tom Sawyer, Detective
summary: In this comedic mystery sequel to The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, young Tom and his friend Huckleberry Finn find themselves embroiled in a tangled web of deception involving stolen diamonds, mistaken identities, and murder. After hearing rumors that Jubiter Dunlap, the long-lost twin brother of their acquaintance Brace Dunlap, may have been murdered, Tom becomes determined to solve the case. Through clever detective work, they uncover a conspiracy in which Brace fakes his own brother's death to frame their uncle Silas for murder and seize control of the family fortune. The boys must outwit the cunning conspirators, expose the truth, and clear their beloved uncle’s name before he is unjustly hanged.
